# R6.34 — E2-T0: stage-one design records + opt-in model-port wire-fidelity members (manifest 292)

$0 offline records-and-machinery ticket. The stage-one E2 spec changes
exist as records before the code that needs them (X-01), and the model
port's wire-fidelity gaps close as opt-in `model_port` /
`transcript_render` members — a definition declaring none renders
byte-identically to today (AC-5). No spend, no live-service claims, no
`spec/` edits.

Run ledger: `docs/build/runs/R6.34.md`.

## What the change contains

- **Stage 1 (`b3a8800a`)** — ADR-0440 (AR-21: model port renders the
  compiled `ModelSurface`; durable rendering refs), ADR-0441 (AR-22:
  `hh-embed/1` exec arming, `stdio = merged`/`exec_defaults`, HH-native
  participant topology with the C-05 ladder verbatim), ADR-0442 (AR-23:
  `hh-tmpl/1`, `json_head_tail@1`/`text_head_tail@1`, `error_format`);
  the AR-24 AMEND-C **draft** (before/after §5e.1 `stop_rule` gaining
  `submit{marker, line, require_returncode}`, marker literal = harness
  data) for GATE-G24; ADR index + revisit triggers regenerated.
- **Stage 2 (`19652a00`)** —
  - `model_port{transport, stream_member, tool_choice}`: `non_stream`
    rides the existing `completion_frames` decoder (REQ-XE-107);
    member-presence choices are declared, never default-changed.
  - `transcript_render{assistant_replay{content,reasoning,
    extra_members}, text_only_turn, format_error_turn,
    id_normalisation, tool_arguments}`: replayed assistant bytes fold
    from the durable `hh.model_io/1` blob through the new
    `LedgerSink::blob_read` seam (X-04); unresolvable refs refuse
    `malformed_history` (REQ-XE-108).
  - `ChunkTranslator` preserves `reasoning_content` and message-level
    extra members into the blob frames (`stream_end.data.message_extra`).

## Tests

`crates/hh-embed/tests/r6_34.rs` — 6 tests (non-stream golden + recorded
`chat.completion` decode; BM18/BM4–BM10 replay goldens; spaced-arguments
byte-exact round-trip; provider ids in `tool_calls[].id` +
`tool_call_id`; blob-sourced-bytes pin; typed refusal on unresolvable
ref; byte-identical legacy). Removing the member decode or the blob
seam re-fails AC-3/AC-4 legs.

Golden fixtures `tests/fixtures/r6_34/*.json` —
`provenance: hand_derived` (REQ-XE-114; never evidence until the
O-recorded corpus lands).
